company.name: Pyka
company.shortDescription: Pyka is a robotics company on a mission to build the most useful autonomous aircraft on Earth.
company.description: Pyka is a robotics company on a mission to build the most useful autonomous aircraft on Earth. At the core of every Pyka aircraft is a vertically integrated aircraft-first robotics stack: proprietary flight control software, avionics, high-power density electric motors, motor controllers, batteries, and carbon fiber composite airframes, developed entirely in-house and manufactured in the United States of America. Learn more at www.flypyka.com.

aiResearchSummary.text: Pyka is engaged in research and development of autonomous electric aircraft, focusing on unmanned aerial vehicle aerial spraying control, as described in methods, systems, and apparatus for controlling chemical spraying by UAVs. Additionally, work on an aircraft propulsion system details a fuselage with wings, booms, and both front and rear propulsion systems. These efforts highlight Pyka’s focus on autonomous aerial spraying and advanced propulsion technologies.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $40,000,000, or 45.4% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $11,302,034 to $314,447,445, a 27.82x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
